title: Breaking Bad
facts: The series ran on AMC from January 20, 2008 to September 29, 2013.
Breaking Bad has 62 episodes across five seasons.
The series is set and was filmed in Albuquerque, New Mexico.
Bryan Cranston won four Emmy Awards for playing Walter White.
Aaron Paul won three Emmy Awards for playing Jesse Pinkman.
Anna Gunn won two Emmy Awards for playing Skyler White.
Vince Gilligan described the idea of the show as turning "Mr. Chips into Scarface".
Jesse Pinkman was first planned to die in season one.
Breaking Bad won the Emmy Award for Outstanding Drama Series in 2013 and 2014.
The spin-off series Better Call Saul premiered in 2015.
The story continued in the 2019 film El Camino: A Breaking Bad Movie.
Walter's alias, Heisenberg, comes from the physicist Werner Heisenberg.
Bryan Cranston and Vince Gilligan first worked together on "Drive", an episode of The X-Files.
Season one has only seven episodes, because of the 2007-08 writers' strike.
Giancarlo Esposito plays Gus Fring, owner of the Los Pollos Hermanos restaurants.
